title: Symmetry of the encoded edge relation
statement: Let $x$ be a binary string and $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for all $u,v<n$, the bit of $x$ at position $2n+2+2(un+v)$ is true if and only if the bit at position $2n+2+2(vn+u)$ is true, where an out-of-range position is read as false. Then the relation on vertices $u,v\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ that holds when the bit at position $2n+2+2(un+v)$ is true is symmetric.
hypotheses_covered: For all natural numbers $u,v<n$, the encoded edge bits for $(u,v)$ and $(v,u)$ agree
